# Manchester Digital

> > Greater Manchester's not-for-profit industry body representing 400+ tech and digital companies, fostering sector growth through community, events, skills development, and policy advocacy.

Manchester Digital serves as the central hub for the Greater Manchester tech ecosystem, connecting businesses, professionals, and entrepreneurs through membership programmes, events, apprenticeships, and sector insights. The organization advocates for regional tech economy growth while supporting startups, skills development, and industry collaboration.

- [What we do | Manchester Digital](https://www.manchesterdigital.com/what-we-do): Overview of Manchester Digital's work supporting the tech sector and members

## Support Programmes & Skills Development

- [Programmes | Manchester Digital](https://www.manchesterdigital.com/programmes): Overview of Manchester Digital's support programmes and skills development initiatives
- [Digital Apprenticeships | Manchester Digital](https://www.manchesterdigital.com/programmes/apprenticeships): Level 4 digital apprenticeship programme for software developers in Greater Manchester
- [Startups | Manchester Digital](https://www.manchesterdigital.com/startups): Startup support hub featuring Startup Activator and resources for tech entrepreneurs

## Community & Networking

- [Digital Events in Manchester | Manchester Digital](https://www.manchesterdigital.com/events): Directory of tech and digital events across Greater Manchester and North West
- [MD Live](https://www.manchesterdigital.com/events-overview): Overview of Manchester Digital's flagship events and professional development opportunities
- [Tech and Digital Business Directory | Manchester Digital](https://www.manchesterdigital.com/members): Searchable directory of member tech and digital companies in Manchester
- [Join the #MDTechCommunity Slack Channel | Manchester Digital](https://www.manchesterdigital.com/slack-channel): Slack channel for Manchester Digital tech community networking and collaboration

- [Tech and Digital Jobs in Manchester | Manchester Digital](https://www.manchesterdigital.com/jobs): Job board featuring tech and digital career opportunities across Greater Manchester

## Research, Insights & Sector Analysis

- [Research & Insights | Manchester Digital](https://www.manchesterdigital.com/representing-the-sector/research-and-insights): Published research and industry insights on Greater Manchester's digital tech sector
- [A Manifesto for the Northern Tech Economy](https://www.manchesterdigital.com/manifesto-for-the-northern-tech-economy): Policy manifesto with recommendations for Greater Manchester's tech economy growth
